calibration.reference_labels: blinded Gemini judgments with machine-authored source references
calibration.fit_objective: 4 * false High labels + missed High labels; fixed citation, conflict, OCR and question-coverage guards
calibration.note: Pilot tuning against fallible model judgments, not human calibration or a truth probability.
calibration.deployment_review: Website defaults to Gemini selection/review when configured. CLI retains same-provider default. Local Qwen self-review High is provisionally capped at Medium after two held-out overratings; Gemini-reviewed Qwen is eligible for High.
